subject: CS351
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos, 5 for each language, covering all specified topics. For English, high-quality, focused tutorials from channels like Neso Academy and Sudhakar Atchala were chosen. For Arabic, selections relied heavily on university open courseware and academic lectures, which provided the most relevant and high-quality content, especially for complex topics. The topic 'Multiprocessor Load Balancing' had limited focused videos in Arabic, leading to the selection of a broader lecture that contained the required concepts.
